successCriteria.description: A new shared module exports startOfUtcDay, addMonths, and periodContaining whose UTC arithmetic is byte-for-byte equivalent to the current private LeaveService helpers, including the 10,000-iteration safety bound and the ConflictError when the date precedes the anchor.

LeaveService no longer defines private startOfUtcDay/addMonths/periodContaining and its resolveBalance calls the shared periodContaining, with no observable behaviour change to create/submit/approve/reject/cancel.

IBalanceService gains getBalanceForEmployee(employeeId) returning a LIST (array) of balance entries — never a single object — where each entry carries leaveTypeCode, periodStart, periodEnd, entitledDays, usedDays, pendingDays, and available = entitledDays - usedDays - pendingDays.

getBalanceForEmployee resolves the current period for each leave type via the shared periodContaining(employee.hireDate, policy.accrualPeriodMonths, new Date()) and looks each balance up with findByKey, performing no writes and opening no transaction.

A balance route registers GET /balances/me (200) that resolves the actor from request.user (never a client-supplied id) via a resolveActor helper matching leave.routes.ts, calls getBalanceForEmployee(actor.id), and maps errors via sendError.
balance/index.ts exports balanceRoutes and app.ts registers it so the endpoint is reachable at runtime.

constraints: The shared accrual helpers must be the single source of truth: LeaveService must import them and delete its private copies; no duplicate period-derivation logic may remain in leave.service.ts or balance.service.ts.
getBalanceForEmployee is read-only: it must not open a transaction, not call uow.withTransaction, and not perform any repository write (create/update).
The actor identity must come exclusively from request.user; the route must never accept or honour a client-supplied employee id.
No unit tests are added in this phase (they land in Phase 5).
outOfScope: Unit tests for the extracted accrual helpers, the balance service, and the balance route (Phase 5).
GET /leaves and GET /leaves/:id read endpoints and their role-scoped visibility (Phase 4).
Any audit-log writes, notifications, or state-changing balance operations — this phase is read-only.

ambiguities.description: How getBalanceForEmployee enumerates the set of leave types to return balances for (all LeaveTypeCode enum members vs. only leave types that have a persisted row/policy).
options: Iterate leave types returned by ILeaveTypeService.findAll
Iterate only leave types that have a policy via getPolicyByLeaveTypeCode

ambiguities.description: What getBalanceForEmployee returns when a leave type has a policy but no balance row exists for the current period (skip the type vs. throw NotFoundError).
options: Skip the leave type (omit from the list)
Throw NotFoundError for the missing balance

entityInvariants.invariant: A balance entry returned by getBalanceForEmployee is a projection of an existing LeaveBalance row: leaveTypeCode, periodStart, periodEnd, entitledDays, usedDays, pendingDays are the persisted values, and available is derived as entitledDays - usedDays - pendingDays (never persisted).

periodContaining(anchor, accrualMonths, date) returns the half-open UTC period [start, end) containing date, anchored at startOfUtcDay(anchor), stepping accrualMonths at a time with a 10,000-iteration bound; a date strictly before the anchor throws ConflictError.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Caller is the authenticated actor; the employeeId is the actor's own id resolved at the route boundary from request.user.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Read-only; throws NotFoundError when the employee or a policy is missing, and propagates ConflictError from periodContaining when the current date precedes the hire-date anchor.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Requires an authenticated actor (request.user with a valid EmployeeRole); missing/invalid actor → 401.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: 200 with a list of balance entries; AppError mapped to { error, code } with its status, other throws → 500.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The extracted startOfUtcDay/addMonths/periodContaining must reproduce the exact UTC arithmetic, safety bound, and ConflictError semantics of the current private helpers in LeaveService.resolveBalance.

The balance route's resolveActor and sendError helpers must match the behaviour of the existing leave route helpers (actor from request.user, role membership check, AppError → { error, code } with status, other → 500).

getBalanceForEmployee must resolve the policy's accrualPeriodMonths via IPolicyService.getPolicyByLeaveTypeCode and the employee's hireDate via IEmployeeService.getEmployeeById, matching how LeaveService.resolveBalance derives the period.
The balance lookup must use IBalanceRepository.findByKey(employeeId, leaveTypeCode, periodStart, periodEnd) with the same key semantics (at-most-one row per key).
The returned entry's available field must equal entitledDays - usedDays - pendingDays, the same sufficiency arithmetic used by validateSufficiency.

integrationPoints.why: Resolve the employee's hireDate, the accrual anchor for periodContaining.
Resolve accrualPeriodMonths per leave type to compute the current period.
Enumerate the leave types whose balances must be returned.
Single source of truth for accrual-period derivation consumed by both LeaveService and BalanceService.
Error semantics for missing employee/policy and pre-anchor dates.
